title: Residual production credentials in PR-reachable CI are closed, pinned, and given named exits

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Bound to the last implementation commit on this branch, a real ancestor of HEAD. The measurements below were taken against this tree. Rebound to the squash merge SHA by post-merge-lane-close.yml.

verify.stop_reason: Refused by UTV2-1630's staging guard: this workstation holds no staging credential, so the resolved target is not xskgrzbteyqdufktjrjx. Expected and documented behaviour, not a failure of this lane.
verify.authoritative_full_run: the required CI `verify` context, green on this head

import_closure_measurement.method: static walk of `import` / `export ... from` edges from scripts/shadow-scoring-runner.ts, resolving relative specifiers and @unit-talk/* workspace packages to their src entry points; run over origin/main's tree and this branch's tree
import_closure_measurement.why_static: the defect is module-evaluation-time: static imports run before the CLI is parsed, so the static graph is exactly the code that executes before any --dry-run guard can apply
import_closure_measurement.conclusion: A pull request editing packages/domain both fired shadow-parity-required.yml and supplied the code that job ran against production with the service-role key. The merge-base pin named scripts/shadow-scoring-runner.ts alone; the import graph supplied 129 further files inside the same trigger filter.

exposures_closed.defect: static import of apps/api/src/server.js evaluated the PR's own apps/api and packages/domain code at module load, before --dry-run was parsed
exposures_closed.fix: apps/api imports made dynamic and confined to the non-dry-run path, which no PR-triggered job takes; the resulting 4-file closure pinned to the merge base in full
exposures_closed.pin_rationale: @unit-talk/config resolves to .ts source and is what reads the credential; package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml because `pnpm install` runs PR-supplied dependency and lifecycle scripts before any pinned file executes. None are in the workflow's trigger paths, so pinning them costs the check nothing.

exposures_closed.defect: exported into $GITHUB_ENV, which is job-wide: supabase start, supabase db reset, pg_isready, supabase stop and upload-artifact all inherited a live production connection string
exposures_closed.fix: the composite action now also publishes the value as a step output and honours out-env: '' to suppress the job-wide export; only the two steps that read the live catalog name it in their own env: block
exposures_closed.hardening_note: the output is written with a randomly generated heredoc delimiter so a value containing a newline cannot forge a second output key

exposures_closed.defect: dormant workflow holding the broadest credential in the inventory; its teardown job was not behind the branching gate and ran on every closed migration PR
exposures_closed.fix: workflow deleted; scripts/ops/ci-proof.ts repointed at live-schema-parity.yml so its schema-validation control is backed by a workflow that exists
exposures_closed.replacement_is_stronger: live-schema-parity.yml replays EVERY repo migration against a fresh Supabase local stack and diffs against live, versus the preview branch's pending-only push, and holds no management token

exemption_schema_change.rationale: 'it only reads' is a property of the code a job runs, and on a pull_request event that code comes from the PR head. Recording it per exemption forces the distinction to be stated rather than assumed: false is a claim that the credentialed steps run nothing from the checkout; true obliges pinnedBy to name the job's whole runtime closure. privilegeReduction gives each standing privilege a named exit instead of letting it become permanent by being documented.

workflow_production_credential_guard.anti_vacuity: the final test runs the scanner against the real workflow directory, so a scanner matching nothing fails rather than reporting clean

shadow_scoring_runner.before: reported 9 of 12 tests and exited non-zero — importing the module fired main(), which threw on absent credentials and called process.exit(1) mid-suite; the file was omitted from every pnpm test:* script so nothing noticed
shadow_scoring_runner.fix: main() runs only when the file is the process entrypoint, compared by resolved real path so a rename, copy, symlink or compiled-.js invocation cannot fail it open

privilege_reduction_blocked_on.claim: the shadow-parity service-role key cannot be downgraded to an anon key without silently voiding the check
privilege_reduction_blocked_on.consequence: RLS-on with no policy denies every role lacking BYPASSRLS, so an anon key returns count=0 for exactly the tables queryDailyCounts reads. countTable swallows the permission error and returns 0, and the workflow classifies candidatesScanned=0 as a WARNING — surfacing as 'PASSED (with warnings)'. The check would go silently vacuous rather than fail.
privilege_reduction_blocked_on.real_reduction_requires: a dedicated Postgres role with pg_read_all_data over a direct connection (replacing the PostgREST client), or a PostgREST JWT minted for such a role. Both need CREATE ROLE on production — an orchestrator action, out of scope for this lane.
privilege_reduction_blocked_on.explicitly_rejected: adding anon SELECT policies to production, which would expose pick data publicly

orphaned_repository_secrets_recorded.status: referenced by no workflow; both point at the staging project, so this is hygiene rather than exposure
orphaned_repository_secrets_recorded.action_taken: recorded in code so the repo refuses to start using them again silently
orphaned_repository_secrets_recorded.action_NOT_taken: no secret was deleted — secret deletion is an orchestrator-owned action explicitly out of scope for this lane

known_limitations: Live Schema Parity may be red: pre-existing drift between repo migrations and live schema, tracked under UTV2-1274. This lane touches no migration and the check is not a required context.

Readiness Regression Gate may be red and is pre-existing: readiness-score.json reflects production runtime state this diff does not touch. Not a required context. Left red deliberately rather than writing a readiness score this lane has not measured.
File scope lock may be red. Not a required context.
A missing 'Supabase PR DB Branch' check is this lane's deletion of that workflow taking effect. It is not in the required set.

The three retained exemptions still hold production read credentials. Each now records its pin and its privilegeReduction, but the reductions themselves require CREATE ROLE on production and are not performed here.
ci-doctor checks CV1-CV6 degrade to 'skip' with the preview workflow absent. This is the designed behaviour of runPreviewChecks, not a regression.
explicitly_not: no GitHub secret, environment, or Supabase preview branch deleted
no direct-main push, no admin merge, no branch-protection change
no writable DB claim and no pnpm test:db claim
